reason: B offers the more physically plausible and controlled test in conventional bcc HEA superconductors, linking a systematic valence-electron-count series to Tc and electronic specific heat while holding phase and disorder approximately fixed. A relies on annealing selectively reducing chemical disorder—likely also changing ordering, segregation, strain, and grain structure—and its assertion that reduced strain necessarily strengthens electron–phonon coupling is not well founded for dirty s-wave superconductors.
